product.title: Real-time interpreting – right in the browser
product.intro: Smart Speech Flow combines speech recognition, translation and speech output in one continuous process. Staff and visitors speak or write in their own language; the other side receives the translation instantly as text and audio.

steps.title: Voice or text input
steps.text: Staff or citizens speak or write in their own language.

steps.title: Automatic processing
steps.text: The system recognises speech, translates the content and prepares it for the recipient.

steps.title: Text and audio output
steps.text: The recipient receives a readable translation and, optionally, spoken output.

steps.title: Real-time dialogue
steps.text: Language barriers turn into a direct exchange – on two devices of the municipality or with the visitor’s own phone.

benefits.title: 20 languages in real time
benefits.text: The 20 most common foreign languages in Germany, translated as text and audio.

benefits.title: Runs in the browser
benefits.text: No installation, no special hardware: existing devices are enough.

benefits.title: Ready within 2 days
benefits.text: No months-long rollout project: after booking we set up the server and you can start.

benefits.title: Separate areas per department
benefits.text: Create your organisation and set up separate areas and rules for individual departments.

benefits.title: Open source under the MIT licence
benefits.text: Open source code, locally operated open-source models, no vendor lock-in.

product.techText: Smart Speech Flow uses a modular architecture with speech-to-text, translation, text-to-speech and WebSocket-based real-time communication. It can be extended, operated and integrated into existing processes in a transparent way.
product.blackboxText: The source code is openly available under the MIT License. This creates transparency and adaptability – and keeps your municipality independent in the long term.

useCases.title: Use it wherever understanding matters
useCases.intro: Smart Speech Flow is made for situations where people who speak different languages need to communicate directly and clearly – in administration, advice services and wherever you deal with citizens.
useCases.fieldsTitle: Where Smart Speech Flow adds value

fields.title: Citizen services and administration
fields.text: In the office, at a service point or on the move: staff talk directly with citizens, regardless of the language they speak.

fields.title: Social and integration advice
fields.text: Direct understanding is essential in sensitive consultations. Conversations become more accessible and structured – without waiting for external interpreters.

fields.title: Community work and meeting places
fields.text: In community centres, neighbourhood hubs and meeting cafés, communication between professionals and visitors becomes clearer.

fields.title: Mobile and decentralised settings
fields.text: Also for home visits, events or temporary advice services – simply in the browser.

useCases.practiceText: Smart Speech Flow was developed together with the City of Kassel and tested under real conditions at the Stadtteilzentrum Wesertor. Everyday speech is translated clearly into German and vice versa – directly in the conversation, without waiting for an interpreter. Smart Speech Flow is now in use in several municipalities.
useCases.transferText: As an open-source solution with municipal roots, Smart Speech Flow can be used in other cities, districts and institutions without an adaptation project.

project.title: Behind the project
project.intro: A joint project by City of Kassel and Smart Village Solutions SVS GmbH. Smart Speech Flow grew out of a concrete need in everyday municipal work: reducing language barriers in public and social settings.
origin: Every day, people without a shared language meet in community centres, advice services and public facilities. The idea: a digital tool that makes these encounters noticeably easier.

Smart Speech Flow was developed in the context of Smart Kassel / Smart City Kassel and tested at the Stadtteilzentrum Wesertor in Kassel – under real conditions and with feedback from the people there.
project.fundingText: Smart Speech Flow is supported through the Smart Cities Model Projects programme of the German federal government, which helps municipalities develop and test digital solutions.
project.partnersTitle: Who is behind Smart Speech Flow

partners.name: City of Kassel
partners.text: The City of Kassel shapes Smart Speech Flow jointly with SVS through the Smart Kassel office. It contributes municipal requirements and tests the application with local people at the Wesertor community centre.

partners.name: Smart Village Solutions SVS GmbH
partners.text: Smart Village Solutions develops Smart Speech Flow jointly with the City of Kassel. SVS is responsible for technical implementation, the open system architecture and platform operations.

why.title: Designed for municipalities
why.text: Created from a real need in everyday municipal work, not as an abstract technology project.

why.title: Open and extensible
why.text: Municipal practice and open source – a foundation for reuse, transfer and digital sovereignty.

openSource.title: Open source as a principle
openSource.intro: The source code of Smart Speech Flow is openly available under the MIT License. The software therefore belongs to your municipality – transparent, verifiable and extensible.
openSource.mitText: The MIT License is a well-established open-source licence. It permits use, adaptation, distribution and integration into your own systems as long as the licence notice is retained – without licence fees or complex legal barriers.

principles.title: Transparency
principles.text: Every line of code can be inspected and understood.

principles.title: Further development
principles.text: Your own adaptations to specific requirements are possible.

principles.title: Reusability
principles.text: Use in other projects and municipalities – without licence fees or vendor lock-in.

principles.title: Collaboration
principles.text: A strong foundation for integrations and joint development.

openSource.operateTitle: Run it yourself or let us run it
openSource.operateText: You can operate Smart Speech Flow on your own servers. Or leave operation, updates and servers to SVS – from €250 per month, ready within 2 days.
openSource.contribute: External contributions are possible through GitHub issues and pull requests. Formal contribution guidelines are being prepared. If you are interested in working with us, please get in touch.

legal.translationNote: This is a translation of the German legal text for information purposes. In case of discrepancies, the German version prevails.

sections.title: 2. General information on data processing
paragraphs: Protecting your personal data is important to us. We process your data solely in accordance with the applicable legal provisions (GDPR, BDSG and TMG). This privacy policy explains the most important aspects of data processing on our website.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and provision of the website
paragraphs: When you visit our website, the hosting provider automatically records information transmitted by your browser in server log files. This includes:
list: Host name of the accessing device
after: This data cannot be attributed to specific individuals and is not combined with other data sources. It is collected on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the technical provision of the website).

sections.title: 4. Contact form
paragraphs: If you contact us using the website form, the data you provide (name, organisation, email address, category and message) is stored and processed so that we can handle your enquiry.

The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures) or Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to enquiries). Your data will be deleted once your enquiry has been fully processed, unless statutory retention obligations apply.

sections.title: 6. Your rights

sections.title: 7. External links
paragraphs: Our website contains links to external third-party websites whose content we cannot control. The respective provider is responsible for linked content. The pages were checked for possible legal violations when the links were created, and no unlawful content was apparent at that time.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this privacy policy

If you have questions about privacy, you can contact us at any time: info@smart-village.solutions
